ruleDefinitions.name: T1574.006 — LD_PRELOAD Hijacking (Fact #49)
ruleDefinitions.description: LD_PRELOAD Hijacking. Trigger: SSH password authentication success on the same host shortly after a linker-configuration file is modified
ruleDefinitions.detectionReason: SSH login success for root on {host} from {src_ip}
ruleDefinitions.suppressScope: JoinIfExists(EntityId('type: User && direction: Source'), EntityId('type: Device && direction: Source'))
